name: accept-thumbsup-for-head-sha
provenance: Real record. codex `+1` on issues/6097/reactions, zero inline comments, and the summary's Commit cell names `a942d79` which IS `pulls/6097` head. This replaces the original accept fixture (#6070), which the pre-PR adversarial review showed was a STALE 👍 — its reaction named `44b4546` while head had moved to `041fce5`. Recording a stale PR as the accept arm would have pinned the bug in as correct. Measured across the 100 most recent PRs: 13 carried a codex 👍, of which 8 named head and 5 named a commit that had been rebased away (#6070, #6076, #6016, #5916, #5912) — a ~38% stale rate, which is why the stale arm below is not hypothetical.
